name: store_distance_between_objects

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_StoreDistanceBetweenObjects consumes three values, resolves the latter two as objects, stores their integer Euclidean separation through the work-variable offset recorded by the first value's load, and decrements Script stackTop by three

notes: The VM's LOAD_VAR32 operation records its work-variable offset at Script+0x204 while pushing the variable's current value. ScriptCommand_StoreDistanceBetweenObjects uses that recorded offset as the destination, ignores destination_value itself, computes the 3D distance between the two resolved object positions, converts it to an integer, and stores it back to the work-variable bank. All 29 JP calls pass a loaded variable as the first argument.
